name: fused_eh_norm
description: fused_eh_norm(inputs_embeds, previous_hidden, enorm_weight, hnorm_weight, eps) -> out. inputs_embeds and previous_hidden have shape [N, D]; enorm_weight and hnorm_weight have shape [D]. Compute e = RMSNorm(inputs_embeds, enorm_weight, eps) and h = RMSNorm(previous_hidden, hnorm_weight, eps) in fp32 as x * rsqrt(mean(x^2) + eps) * weight, then concatenate [e, h] along the last dimension and cast to inputs_embeds.dtype. Returns a newly allocated [N, 2D] tensor. No input mutation. The exercised dtype is bfloat16 with D in {512, 2048, 4096, 7168}.
